summary: Frontend-only test of the Manage Directories 'Folders from Add Files' section (v1.7.0). I used the simulated electronAPI harness and a mocked TMDB, plus a new spy that records any electronAPI delete/remove/trash/unlink call. New file: /app/tests/test_iter39_file_dirs.py. Results: (1) SECTION PASS. After Add Files (3 Breaking Bad files from D:\Downloads\Breaking Bad, added as Movies), the file-dirs-section shows file-dir-0 with the name 'Breaking Bad', the path, file-dir-type-0='movies' and the count '3 titles'. The scanned M:\Movies shows only as a scanned row and is not repeated. A stale dir_categories key (Q:\Gone, no titles) is hidden. After all Add Files folders are removed, the section is hidden. (2) TYPE SWITCH PASS. Each switch saves to obsidian_cinema_dir_categories, and the badges update: tv gives 'TV Shows 3', movies gives 'Movies 4', and docs and anim work the same way. TV, Docs and Anim each open the 'Shows found in this folder' dialog with group show|d:\downloads\breaking bad (3 files). Movies opens no dialog. After merging as TV: 1 card with 3 parts, and the row shows type tv, '1 titles'. (3) REMOVE PASS for normal folders. With Add Files folders D:\Downloads (Alien, Aliens) and D:\Downloads\Sub (Up), plus the scanned M:\Movies (Heat, Ronin), the dialog says 'removes the 2 titles you added from Downloads'. Cancel keeps all 5 cards and the categories. Confirm removes only Alien and Aliens; Up (subfolder) and Heat and Ronin (scanned) stay. The D:\Downloads key is deleted and the Sub key is kept. The toast reads 'Removed 2 titles from your library'. No electronAPI delete-type calls were made, and there were no page errors. (4) REGRESSIONS PASS. Scanned rows: dir-type change, up/down reorder, the rename dialog, and dir-mgr-remove (removes the TV dir and its title, and keeps the Add Files row) all work. iter38: run_loose_heuristics 6/6, run_button_text (Cancel now resets the picker, the earlier LOW is fixed), run_nested_badge (badge 3 = 3 cards, the earlier MEDIUM is fixed). iter37 run_add_files: tv, docs, movies, existing tv dir, and the naming-tip variant all match the baseline. Two edge-case bugs were found with Add Files inside scanned directories (see issues).

ui_bugs.component: Folders from Add Files - subfolder of a scanned directory
ui_bugs.issue: Scanned dir M:\Movies has the scanned title M:\Movies\Extra\Ronin.mkv. The user then uses Add Files on M:\Movies\Extra\Up.mkv. M:\Movies\Extra is shown as a 'Folders from Add Files' row with '2 titles' (the scanned Ronin is counted). Remove deletes BOTH, so a scanned-directory title is removed even though the spec says it must not be. Cause: fileDirs only excludes exact matches in directories (!directories.includes(d)), and inFileDir matches any title whose parent folder equals d. Fix: hide or exclude folders that sit inside a scanned directory (directories.some(r => inDir(d, r))), or count and remove only titles that are not under any scanned directory.

This bug existed before this change. Add Files on M:\Movies\Up.mkv as TV, where M:\Movies is a scanned Movies dir, rewrites dir_categories so that M:\Movies becomes tv. The whole scanned Movies folder silently turns into TV (dir-type-0 = tv), with no row in the new section to show why. Fix: when the parent folder of a picked file is already a scanned directory (or inside one), skip applyImportType for that folder or ask the user first.
Plural text is wrong: '1 titles', and 'Removed 1 titles from your library'. The scanned row also shows '1 titles'.

issues: Clicking file-dir-remove closes Manage Directories. After Cancel in file-dir-remove-dialog, the manager does not reopen, so the user has to open it again. Same behaviour as the scanned-row remove; small UX point.

action_items: MEDIUM: Exclude Add Files folders that are inside a scanned directory from the file-dirs section (or exclude scanned titles from the count and from removeFileDir), so Remove never drops scanned titles.
MEDIUM: Add Files should not overwrite the type of an existing scanned directory (or a folder inside one) in dir_categories.
LOW: Fix the plurals in the 'N titles' labels and the remove toast.
critical_code_review_comments: removeFileDir does not clean favorites or collection ids of the removed titles (removeDirectory does not either). The orphaned ids stay in localStorage.
fileDirs and count are computed inline with movies.filter for each row on every render of the dialog. This is fine for small libraries, but it is O(dirs*movies).
inFileDir uses m.file_path. For a merged multipart card whose parts come from different folders, only the first part's folder is used.

success_rate.frontend: ~93%: all 4 requested feature areas pass, plus all regressions; 2 MEDIUM edge cases (Add Files inside scanned dirs) and 1 LOW plural issue

seed_data_creation: None. Isolated browser contexts with localStorage/sessionStorage mocks only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Usage: g={'page':page}; exec(open('/app/tests/test_iter39_file_dirs.py').read(), g) (loads iter38 -> 37 -> ...). Functions: run_fd_type_switch, run_fd_remove, run_fd_edges (prints the 2 MEDIUM edge cases (a) and (b)), run_scanned_rows_regress. open5() adds a SPY on electronAPI delete/remove/trash calls (window.__fsCalls). mgr(p) opens the manager only if it is not already open.
